Help-center excerpts:

[savings-tax-forms] Tax forms for interest (effective 2025-01-01)
If you earn at least $10.00 in interest during a calendar year, we send you a Form 1099-INT.

## When it's available

By January 31 of the following year. You'll find it in the app under Profile, then Documents, then Tax forms. We'll notify you when it's ready.

## Earned less?

If you earned less than the threshold, we don't send a form, but the interest is still shown on your monthly statements. You may still need to report it.

## Premium ATM surcharge refunds and bonuses

ATM surcharge

[savings-tax-forms] Tax forms for interest (effective 2025-01-01)
report it.

## Premium ATM surcharge refunds and bonuses

ATM surcharge refunds aren't interest and don't appear on the form. Referral bonuses may be reported separately.

## Tax questions

We can't give tax advice. For questions about how to report interest, talk to a tax professional.

## Wrong details on the form

If your name or taxpayer ID on the form is wrong, message support. Changes to your legal name or taxpayer ID go to our Verification team.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[close-statements] Statements after closing (effective 2025-01-01)
After you close your account, you can still sign in and download statements for 90 days.

## Download them before you go

We recommend downloading any statements and tax forms you might need before you close. Tap Profile, then Documents.

## After that

Once the download period ends, you can't sign in. Message support from the sign-in screen, or email us, and we'll send the statements you need. We keep records for seven years.

## Tax forms

If you earned at least $10.00 in interest in the year you closed, we still send your 1099-INT

[savings-interest-calc] How savings interest is calculated (effective 2025-01-01)
up to $100,000. Anything above that earns 0.10% APY.

## Changing plans

If you change plans, the new rate applies from the day the change takes effect. Interest for earlier days in the month uses the old rate.

## Rate changes

Rates are variable. We give at least 30 days notice by email before we lower a rate.

Your main balance doesn't earn interest.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.

[support-no-advice] Financial advice (effective 2025-01-01)
and Savings Pockets work
- Fees and limits on each plan, so you can decide which suits you
- Your statements and tax forms

## Where to get advice

For advice about your situation, talk to a qualified financial adviser, tax professional or lawyer.

## Investing

Tallowbrook doesn't offer investment or brokerage accounts. See "Investing and cryptocurrency".

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[products-business] Business accounts (effective 2025-01-01)
into your personal account.

## Business debit cards

Your Tallowbrook card is a personal debit card. It can't carry a business name.

## Tax forms

We only issue interest tax forms. We can't issue forms for business income.

## Looking for a business account?

You'll need a bank that offers business accounts. We can't recommend a specific one.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[savings-apy-basic-v2] Savings rate on Basic (effective 2026-06-01)
We'll email you at least 30 days before a decrease.

## How to start earning

Tap Savings, then New pocket, and move money in from your main balance. Moving money in and out is instant and free. Interest for each month is paid into the pocket on the first business day of the next month.

## If you change plans

Your pockets start earning the new plan's rate on the day the change takes effect. Upgrades take effect right away and downgrades on your next billing date.

## Earn more

Plus members earn 2.00% APY on the same

[savings-apy-basic-v2] Savings rate on Basic (effective 2026-06-01)
On the Basic plan, Savings Pockets earn 0.50% APY, effective June 1, 2026.

## Details

- The rate applies to combined pocket balances up to $100,000. Anything above earns 0.10% APY.
- Interest compounds daily and is paid monthly.
- Your main balance doesn't earn interest. Move money to a pocket to earn it.
- There's no minimum balance and no limit on withdrawals.

## Rates are variable

We may change the rate. We'll email you at least 30 days before a decrease.

You are the help-center assistant for Tallowbrook, a US neobank. Answer the customer's question using only the help-center excerpts you are given.

Rules:
- Use only facts stated in the excerpts. Do not add fees, limits, dates, steps or products they do not mention.
- Some excerpts are older versions of a policy. When two excerpts disagree, follow the one with the later effective date.
- If the question depends on the customer's plan (Basic, Plus or Premium), use that plan's numbers.
- If the question rests on something false (for example a fee that does not exist), say so and give the correct facts. That is an answer, not an abstention.
- Abstain when the excerpts do not contain the answer, when the question is not about Tallowbrook, or when it asks for investment, tax or legal advice. Set "abstain" to true and say briefly that the help center does not cover it.
- Cite the article IDs (the text in square brackets) of every excerpt you used. Cite nothing when you abstain.
- Keep the answer short: two to four sentences, plain language.
